summary: Sorn is a destination fine-dining restaurant serving Southern Thai cuisine in a restored house on Sukhumvit 26. It is a special-occasion, multi-course dinner; Michelin lists it at the top price tier and currently awards three stars.
whyGo: Explore Southern Thai ingredients, recipes and slow techniques in a carefully paced tasting menu.
The restaurant draws on the chef-owner’s research and relationships across all 14 Southern Thai provinces.
bestFor: A planned culinary splurge for diners curious about regional Thai cuisine.
Travelers able to commit to a fixed menu and book well ahead.
skipIf: You want a casual or inexpensive meal, need a flexible à la carte choice, or cannot accommodate a long tasting-menu dinner.
You have strict dietary needs; ask the restaurant whether it can accommodate them before booking.
duration: Plan about 3–4 hours for the tasting-menu dinner (estimate; confirm the seating length with the restaurant).
cost: The official TableCheck listing shows the Classic Menu at ฿7,800 before 10% service charge and 7% VAT. Budget roughly ฿9,126 if both are added to the listed price; confirm the final bill and any beverage pairing cost when booking.
hours: Michelin currently lists dinner 18:00–22:00 Sunday–Friday and closed Saturday. Check the December booking calendar for holiday changes.
bestTime: For December 2026, book as soon as the release window opens. Choose a date that fits the trip rather than relying on a walk-in.
gettingThere: At 56 Soi Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Toei. Use the restaurant’s map pin and take a taxi or ride-hail to the address; allow extra time for Sukhumvit traffic. The restaurant lists limited car parking through Michelin, but confirm availability before driving.
booking: The restaurant says international guests can email reservation@sornfinesouthern.com from 00:00 Bangkok time on November 15 for the following month. Online reservations open at 12:00 Bangkok time on November 25 for the following month through TableCheck. Ask about December dates, the menu served, dietary needs, deposit and cancellation terms; the current Seasonal Menu dates are October and November, with full launch planned for early January 2027.
accessibility: The official site describes a restored house but does not publish step-free access, accessible toilet or seating details. Contact the restaurant before booking to discuss mobility needs.
practicalTips: Set a reminder for the international email release and include your preferred date, party size and a backup date.
The current Classic Menu is recommended for first-time guests; TableCheck lists its price before service charge and VAT.
Confirm spice level and any dietary restrictions directly; the menu’s December dishes are not yet published.
decemberNotes: December 2026 reservations are expected to open November 15 (international email) and November 25 (online), Bangkok time. The restaurant’s Seasonal Menu is listed for selected October and November dates, with its full launch planned for early January 2027; December offerings are not yet specified. No December holiday closure schedule is published in the sources checked, so verify dates directly before arranging the evening around it.
uncertainties: December 2026 service dates, holiday closures, menu composition and final booking inventory are not published yet.
The tasting-menu duration, accessibility provisions, dietary accommodations and final charges should be confirmed with the restaurant.
